description: This file defines the OrderTotalSummary class used to encapsulate total calculation details for an order, including subtotal, total, tax, and a list of additional fee components.

classes.name: OrderTotalSummary
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing the summary of order totals, including subtotal, total, tax, and other fees.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of additional totals such as taxes, shipping, etc.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of additional totals.
